    Being 2 weeks ready means having a household emergency plan and at least 14 days worth of supplies. Read on...

  4. Storm Water System Repair and Drainage Ditch Work

    Yachats Ocean Rd. State Natural Site will be experiencing intermittent vehicle traffic congestion and short-term road closures from Tuesday September 22nd to Thursday September 24th to conduct storm water system repair and drainage ditch work Read on...

  5. Proposed Code Updates for Housing

    Yachats has completed a Housing Needs Assessment and Implementation Plan and is now transitioning to updating our city codes.

  6. Little Log Church in search of volunteers!
